sql: SELECT state, year, SUM(CAST(data_value AS DOUBLE)) infant_deaths, COUNT(*) n FROM health.cdc_state_vital_provisional WHERE indicator LIKE '%Infant%' AND state IN ('Louisiana','Alabama','Mississippi') AND year IN ('2024') GROUP BY state, year ORDER BY state

SELECT state_name, MAX(state_expanded_medicaid) exp FROM health.medicaid_chip_enrollment_monthly WHERE state_name IN ('Louisiana','Alabama','Mississippi') AND reporting_period >= '2025-01-01' GROUP BY state_name
